description: This file defines a React functional component 'PreviewComponent' responsible for previewing various types of files (images, videos, audio, text, or other generic files) within a web application. It manages URL creation for file data, handles platform-specific behaviors, and renders appropriate preview elements based on file type.

classes.name: PreviewComponent
classes.description: A React functional component that displays a preview of a file based on its MIME type, supporting images, videos, audio, text, and fallback rendering.

methods.name: openNativeFilePreview
methods.description: An asynchronous callback function that converts file bytes to base64 and opens the file in an external native app if the platform supports native preview.
